verdict.rationale: Rootly's Alert Deduplication feature explicitly collapses repeat events from the same monitor into a single open alert using a stable identifier so responders aren't paged twice, and Alert Routing provides a unified layer to direct alerts to the right team/escalation policy, combining to reduce duplicate paging. Escalation Policies then ensure one incident routes to the correct on-call human via multi-step targets. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of dedup accuracy at scale and no community evidence specifically confirming the anti-noise outcome in production.
